newsitem.title: USA: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. rice weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA rice export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 13,600 MT were down 58 percent from the previous week and 62 percent under the 4-week average.

Germany (2,800 MT), Mexico (2,300 MT, of which 2,000 MT was rough), Saudi Arabia (2,200 MT), and Canada (1,300 MT) were the primary buyers. In addition, reductions of 200 MT of rough rice were reported for Nicaragua.

Exports of 31,100 MT slid 6 percent from the week earlier and 2 percent from the 4-week average. The major destinations were Nicaragua (9,400 MT), Canada (4,900 MT), Ghana (3,300 MT), Mexico (3,200 MT), and Saudi Arabia (2,000 MT).
